question: In 2019, United Nations General Assembly adopted the resolution to hold an International Day of Clean Air for blue skies every year on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7th September.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies – **September 7**, 2022. International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies on September 7 is observed to recognize the importance of clean air in our health and daily lives.
 
• Nairobi, 7 September 2021 – **The world today marked the second International Day of Clean Air** for blue skies under the theme **Healthy Air, Healthy Planet**, which highlights the link between air quality and planetary and human health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The theme for this year's International Day of Clean Air for blue skies is “**Healthy Air, Healthy Planet**” which emphasizes the health effects of air pollution, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic
